title: Agent Memory Cost Map
description: Adjust memory entries per call, call frequency, and gas price to see how monthly on-chain cost diverges across four persistent-memory architectures: SSTORE, event logs, IPFS+CID, and TEE.
controls: drag 'entries / call' slider to scale memory per invocation
drag 'calls / day' slider to set agent frequency
drag 'gas price' slider to model network congestion
